news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.20 (down from ₹6.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹513.9m (up ₹435.3m from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹14.2m (down 26% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.8% (down from 24% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 91% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 190% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
